question: Using Section 4J.03 and Figure 4J-3, give the full pedestrian-hybrid-beacon sequence and identify which stage corresponds to the pedestrian walk interval.
model_answer: Direct Answer: After a pedestrian actuation, a pedestrian hybrid beacon proceeds through the following sequence: (1) dark until activated, (2) flashing circular yellow upon activation, (3) steady circular yellow, (4) both steady circular red indications during the pedestrian walk interval, (5) alternating flashing circular red during the pedestrian change interval, and (6) dark again until the next actuation. The pedestrian walk interval corresponds to Stage 4 — the display of both steady CIRCULAR RED signal indications. Standards (mandatory): - "Following an actuation by a pedestrian, a pedestrian hybrid beacon face shall display a flashing CIRCULAR yellow signal indication, followed by a steady CIRCULAR yellow signal indication, followed by both steady CIRCULAR RED signal indications during the pedestrian walk interval, followed by alternating flashing CIRCULAR RED signal indications during the pedestrian change interval (see Figure 4J-3). Upon ... termination of the pedestrian change interval, the pedestrian hybrid beacon faces shall revert to a dark (not illuminated) condition." - "A pedestrian hybrid beacon face shall consist of three signal sections, with a CIRCULAR YELLOW signal indication centered below two horizontally-aligned CIRCULAR RED signal indications (see Figure 4J-3)." Options (permitted): - Per the note in Figure 4J-3, "An optional steady red clearance interval may be added after Interval 3, and an optional short buffer interval (alternating flashing red while the pedestrian signal heads are displaying a steady UPRAISED HAND) may be added after Interval 5." Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Figure 4J-3 with the six-stage sequence — (1) Dark Until Activated, (2) Flashing Yellow Upon Activation, (3) Steady Yellow, (4) Steady Red During Pedestrian Walk Interval, (5) Alternating Flashing Red During Pedestrian Change Interval, (6) Dark Again Until Activated — with the walk interval explicitly labeled as Stage 4 (both red lenses steady, "SR"). [Image 2] shows the same Figure 4J-3 in the full-page context of page 729 along with the legend (SY steady yellow, FY flashing yellow, SR steady red, FR flashing red). Citations: - Section 4J.03 Standard §2 (p.730) - Section 4J.02 Standard §2 (p.728) - Figure 4J-3 (p.729)
gold_answer: Dark, flashing yellow, steady yellow, both steady red, alternating flashing red, then dark. The both-steady-red stage corresponds to the pedestrian walk interval.
